metadata.title: Azure controls for Grundschutz++ requirements (candidate)
metadata.remarks: Generated from catalogue-mapping.json by tools/oscal/build_component.py. Candidate mapping from Grundschutz++ requirement IDs to Azure controls. No information-security expert has reviewed it. It is not a compliance statement. It holds requirement IDs, modal verbs, security levels and our own mapping only; read the requirement text in your local catalogue extract.

components.title: Azure Policy
components.description: Evaluates Azure resource configuration against built-in policy definitions and audits, denies or remediates it.
components.purpose: Checks the requirements that resource configuration can show.

control-implementations.description: Candidate implementation of Grundschutz++ requirements by Azure Policy. Not a compliance statement.

implemented-requirements.description: Allowed locations (built-in policy 1.1.0); Allowed locations for resource groups (built-in policy 1.1.0).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Azure Policy enforces the deployment region of regional resources. Resources with location 'global' and the provider's jurisdiction need a written record.

implemented-requirements.description: Secure transfer to storage accounts should be enabled (built-in policy 2.0.0); App Service apps should only be accessible over HTTPS (built-in policy 4.0.0); Azure SQL Database should be running TLS version 1.2 or newer (built-in policy 2.0.0).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Services that the application runs inside virtual machines are not evaluated.

implemented-requirements.description: Storage accounts should have the specified minimum TLS version (built-in policy 1.0.0); App Service apps should use the latest TLS version (built-in policy 2.2.0); Azure SQL Database should be running TLS version 1.2 or newer (built-in policy 2.0.0).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: The App Service TLS definition can only audit, not deny.

implemented-requirements.description: Storage accounts should use customer-managed key for encryption (built-in policy 1.1.0); SQL servers should use customer-managed keys to encrypt data at rest (built-in policy 2.0.1).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Platform encryption is always on and cannot be audited per resource. The policies check customer-managed keys, which is stronger than the requirement asks; the storage definition can only audit.

implemented-requirements.description: Audit diagnostic setting for selected resource types (built-in policy 2.0.1); Enable logging by category group for App Service (microsoft.web/sites) to Log Analytics (built-in policy 1.0.0); Enable logging by category group for Key vaults (microsoft.keyvault/vaults) to Log Analytics (built-in policy 1.1.0); Enable logging by category group for SQL databases (microsoft.sql/servers/databases) to Log Analytics (built-in policy 1.1.0); Configure diagnostic settings for Storage Accounts to Log Analytics workspace (built-in policy 4.0.0).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Policy routes platform resource logs. Which events the application itself writes, and guest operating-system events on virtual machines, stay with the application owner.

implemented-requirements.description: Configure Azure Activity logs to stream to specified Log Analytics workspace (built-in policy 1.0.0).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Privileged actions inside the application are logged only if the application writes them.

implemented-requirements.description: Configure Azure Activity logs to stream to specified Log Analytics workspace (built-in policy 1.0.0).
Users must authenticate with multi-factor authentication to create or update resources (built-in policy 1.1.0).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Azure Policy sees only resource writes by users; it cannot see sign-ins, service principals or directory roles. Enforcement sits in Microsoft Entra.

implemented-requirements.description: Network interfaces should not have public IPs (built-in policy 1.0.0); Storage accounts should disable public network access (built-in policy 1.1.0); Public network access on Azure SQL Database should be disabled (built-in policy 1.1.0); Azure Key Vault should disable public network access (built-in policy 1.1.0).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: The requirement concerns direct connections to public networks. The policies remove public endpoints; outbound traffic control is a firewall and routing concern of the platform hub and is not evaluated.

implemented-requirements.description: Subnets should be associated with a Network Security Group (built-in policy 3.0.0).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: The policy checks that a network security group exists, not that its rules restrict connections.

implemented-requirements.description: Azure Backup should be enabled for Virtual Machines (built-in policy 3.0.0).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: No built-in definition in this slice audits backup of storage accounts or App Service content.

implemented-requirements.description: Geo-redundant storage should be enabled for Storage Accounts (built-in policy 1.0.0); Long-term geo-redundant backup should be enabled for Azure SQL Databases (built-in policy 2.0.0).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Geo-redundancy must stay inside the allowed locations; check the paired region against the data-location parameter.

implemented-requirements.description: Machines should be configured to periodically check for missing system updates (built-in policy 3.10.0).
A vulnerability assessment solution should be enabled on your virtual machines (built-in policy 3.0.0) (needs a paid plan).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Defender for Cloud gives posture signals, not enforcement, and its scanners need a paid plan. Without one, the procedure is evidenced by attestation only.

implemented-requirements.description: Require a tag on resources (built-in policy 1.0.1).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Classifying data is an owner's judgement. Policy checks only that a tag exists; Purview needs a licence and is optional in this lab.

components.title: Microsoft Entra ID
components.description: Identity provider: Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management and audit logs.
components.purpose: Enforces sign-in and privileged-access requirements that resource configuration cannot show.

control-implementations.description: Candidate implementation of Grundschutz++ requirements by Microsoft Entra ID. Not a compliance statement.

implemented-requirements.description: Microsoft Entra audit logs exported to the same workspace by a diagnostic setting.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Privileged actions inside the application are logged only if the application writes them.

implemented-requirements.description: Conditional Access policy that requires phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication for privileged directory and Azure roles; Privileged Identity Management: just-in-time activation of privileged roles with multi-factor authentication.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Azure Policy sees only resource writes by users; it cannot see sign-ins, service principals or directory roles. Enforcement sits in Microsoft Entra.

implemented-requirements.description: Conditional Access policy with a phishing-resistant authentication strength for the application's sign-ins from external networks.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Sign-in requirements are not resource configuration; Azure Policy cannot check them.

components.title: Azure platform defaults
components.description: Behaviour Azure services provide without extra configuration, such as encryption at rest with platform-managed keys, automated database backups and the Azure Resource Graph inventory.
components.purpose: Covers requirements that the services meet by default.

control-implementations.description: Candidate implementation of Grundschutz++ requirements by Azure platform defaults. Not a compliance statement.

implemented-requirements.description: Service-side encryption at rest with platform-managed keys, on by default for Azure Storage and Azure SQL.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Platform encryption is always on and cannot be audited per resource. The policies check customer-managed keys, which is stronger than the requirement asks; the storage definition can only audit.

implemented-requirements.description: Automated backups of Azure SQL Database, on by default.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: No built-in definition in this slice audits backup of storage accounts or App Service content.

implemented-requirements.description: Azure Resource Graph inventory of the resources that hold the data.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Resource Graph lists data stores, not the information inside them.

implemented-requirements.description: Azure Policy exemption with description, category and expiry, created only from the approved record.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Azure Policy exemptions make the expiry date optional; only exemptions raised through the pull-request check are guaranteed to have one.

components.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
components.description: Security posture management and vulnerability findings. Optional: the findings used here need a paid plan.
components.purpose: Adds technical evidence for vulnerability requirements where a plan is enabled.

control-implementations.description: Candidate implementation of Grundschutz++ requirements by Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Not a compliance statement.

implemented-requirements.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud vulnerability findings (needs a paid plan).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Defender for Cloud gives posture signals, not enforcement, and its scanners need a paid plan. Without one, the procedure is evidenced by attestation only.

components.title: Microsoft Purview
components.description: Data map and sensitivity labels. Optional: needs a licence.
components.purpose: Adds technical evidence for data inventory and classification where it is licensed.

control-implementations.description: Candidate implementation of Grundschutz++ requirements by Microsoft Purview. Not a compliance statement.

implemented-requirements.description: Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and data map classification (needs a paid plan).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Classifying data is an owner's judgement. Policy checks only that a tag exists; Purview needs a licence and is optional in this lab.

implemented-requirements.description: Microsoft Purview data map (needs a paid plan).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Resource Graph lists data stores, not the information inside them.

components.title: Attestation and exception process
components.description: Records kept in the repository and approved by pull request: attestations for requirements no technical control can check, and time-boxed exceptions with a named approver.
components.purpose: Evidences what technical controls cannot show, and governs every deviation.

control-implementations.description: Candidate implementation of Grundschutz++ requirements by Attestation and exception process. Not a compliance statement.

implemented-requirements.description: Contractual data-location and jurisdiction commitments of the provider, referenced in the repository.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: A contract is not resource configuration; no policy can check it.

implemented-requirements.description: Provider's third-party attestation (for example a C5 type 2 report) obtained from the provider's trust portal and referenced in the repository.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Covers the provider's scope only. The customer's controls are covered by the other themes.

implemented-requirements.description: Recurring review of the provider's attestation and its bridge letters, recorded in the repository.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: The review is a human activity; Azure exposes no control for it.

implemented-requirements.description: Restore test on a representative sample, recorded in the repository by the application owner.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: A restore test is an activity, not a configuration.

implemented-requirements.description: Documented vulnerability-scan procedure with evaluation and handling, recorded in the repository.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Defender for Cloud gives posture signals, not enforcement, and its scanners need a paid plan. Without one, the procedure is evidenced by attestation only.

implemented-requirements.description: Protection-need class assigned by the data owner and recorded in the application profile.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Classifying data is an owner's judgement. Policy checks only that a tag exists; Purview needs a licence and is optional in this lab.

implemented-requirements.description: Information inventory kept with the application profile and reviewed by the data owner.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Resource Graph lists data stores, not the information inside them.

implemented-requirements.description: Every exception is a pull request approved by a named person in the authorising role, enforced by branch protection and code owners.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Branch protection proves who approved, not that the approver had the authority; the authorising role is a governance decision.

implemented-requirements.description: Exception record in the repository with justification, risk owner and expiry date, checked by a pull-request workflow.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Gap: Azure Policy exemptions make the expiry date optional; only exemptions raised through the pull-request check are guaranteed to have one.
